name: ocpf-bc
description: The OnlyCopilotFans Business Central Agentic Development Framework: a guided DEFINE, DESIGN, BUILD, PROVE routine for building AL extensions the right way, per-tenant or for AppSource. Picks Full, Lite, or Build-a-Feature (one object or a few, no steps, four quick documents at the close), sets up the latest runbook, connects Microsoft's AL tools with nothing to install, adds reasoning, light, and generator sub-agents (batches generated in parallel), writes every project document from a template, builds Business Central Copilot features from the verified OnlyBCFans BC Copilot Blueprint in any journey, estimates human and AI effort, measures token usage and cost at every step boundary, and keeps a live HTML dashboard of the build.
